data.name: MainWindow_Description
data.value: This is the base screen for collecting multiple FF14 tools into a single app.

data.name: Section_Overview_Description
data.value: This area will show an overview of each tool and recent status.

data.name: Section_Hotbar_Description
data.value: This area will show hotbar analysis, group checks, and resolved actions.

data.name: Section_Keybind_Description
data.value: This area will show keybind analysis and command lists.

data.name: Section_Crafting_Description
data.value: This area will show crafter action definitions, job mappings, and related data.

data.name: Section_Icons_Description
data.value: This area will handle Lumina-based icon generation and cache status.

data.name: Section_Settings_Description
data.value: This area will manage display language, cache locations, and other settings.

data.name: Shell_StatusReady
data.value: Base UI is ready to use

data.name: Shell_PrimaryPlaceholderBody
data.value: The selected tool's list, details, and actions will live here. The layout is intended to stay roomy for wide views such as hotbar and keybind tools.

data.name: Shell_SecondaryPlaceholderBody
data.value: This area can hold context, shortcuts, future tabs, or secondary details for the selected feature.

data.name: Settings_CachePathDescription
data.value: This path will later be used for opening the cache folder from the app.

data.name: Settings_LanguageCardDescription
data.value: This card will later hold display language and shared settings guidance.

data.name: Overview_PrimaryBody
data.value: This page can later collect tool summaries, recently used features, and current loading state.

data.name: Overview_SecondaryBody
data.value: This side area can point people toward major tools such as Hotbar and Keybind.

data.name: Hotbar_PrimaryBody
data.value: This page will later show hotbar lists, grouped slots, and Lumina-based resolved action names.

data.name: Hotbar_SecondaryBody
data.value: This side area can hold character selection, file paths, filters, and export actions.

data.name: Keybind_PrimaryBody
data.value: This page will later show command lists, assignment states, and prefix summaries.

data.name: Keybind_SecondaryBody
data.value: This side area can hold search, filters, and duplicate-check helpers.

data.name: Crafting_PrimaryBody
data.value: This page will later show crafter action definitions, job mappings, localized names, and icon links.

data.name: Crafting_SecondaryBody
data.value: This side area can hold comparisons between jobs and other related details.

data.name: Icons_PrimaryBody
data.value: This page will later handle converted Lumina icons, generation state, and refresh actions.

data.name: Icons_SecondaryBody
data.value: This side area can show cache counts, last update times, and missing images.
